name: Martin Šuba
title: Engineering Manager
about: Engineering Manager with 10+ years in web product engineering, leading a team that delivers security products to Tier-1 partners at F-Secure. Grew from developer to tech lead to manager on the same product through two acquisitions (SaferPass → Lookout → F-Secure). Focused on growing engineers and predictable delivery. Running AI-orchestrated workflows in my team and exploring how AI-native development reshapes the whole SDLC. Technical enough to guide architecture decisions and review solutions (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, web and native SDKs).

experience.title: Engineering Manager
experience.description: Leading the Solution Implementation team, which configures, releases and delivers cybersecurity products to Tier-1 partners, and owning the team's internal automation and delivery tooling.
highlights: Managing the team: 1:1s, regular feedback, performance reviews and career development.
Owning delivery and release readiness for partner releases: planning around real capacity, managing dependencies across teams and raising risks early.
Introduced AI-orchestrated workflows and agentic automations into delivery, reducing manual effort by up to 80% in selected workflows, and brought the team along in adopting AI tools.
Improving delivery processes and quality in a security-critical, partner-facing environment.

experience.title: Technical Project Lead (alongside the EM role)
highlights: Led Tier-1 partner deliveries end to end, from scope and planning to release.
Coordinated execution across engineering teams and stakeholder groups, unblocking work and keeping commitments aligned.
Improved the delivery process for complex, customer-facing releases.

experience.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
highlights: Led frontend development of the password manager clients: browser extensions and SDKs for TypeScript, iOS and Android.
Owned the architecture for delivering SaferPass as a component of the F-Secure SDK, integrating web and native technologies.
Shipped the SDK release for a Tier-1 partner, enabling the launch of a new product offering.
Partnered with Product on integrating SaferPass into F-Secure products: feasibility, feature scope and a consistent user experience.
Mentored engineers and set technical direction for the frontend.

experience.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
experience.description: SaferPass was acquired by Lookout in 2022; the consumer business moved to F-Secure in 2023.
highlights: Took on team lead responsibilities while staying hands-on in frontend development of the web product and browser extension.
Kept delivery going and supported the team through the acquisition and the move into a larger organization.

experience.title: JavaScript Developer
experience.description: Product startup building a web-based password manager.
highlights: Built the frontend of the web app and browser extension (JavaScript/TypeScript, AngularJS, React, Web Extension APIs, Node.js).
Delivered new features, refactored legacy code and improved test coverage.

experience.title: Front-end Web Developer
experience.description: Responsive web and mobile apps (JavaScript, AngularJS, Angular, Ionic).

experience.title: Front-end Web Developer
experience.description: Web interfaces for client projects including O2, Sberbank, SLSP, VÚB and Hyundai.

experience.title: Front-end Web Developer
experience.description: Web pages, e-mail newsletters and WordPress templates.
